source_fragments.fragment: The drawing and the bill disagree.
The checks use smeared areas at full radius and do not resolve station lengths, sections or connections.
Rendering segments are not physical member counts.
No aircraft has been built or flown.
const gi = (aISmeared, aTheta, aOExtra, aSpoke, knockdown)
let rec = gi(aI / bay, aTh, aOe, aSp, knockdown);
gi(aI1 / bay, aTh1, aOe1, aSp1, SHIP0.giKnockdownFrame)

source_identity_mappings.source_role: Source explicitly uses smeared areas at full radius.

source_locators.fragment: The checks use smeared areas at full radius and do not resolve station lengths, sections or connections.

source_identity_mappings.limit: This published limitation is not a matched discrete reference-cell or assembled-system validation record.

source_identity_mappings.source_role: Local bay identifier comes from the source SHIP0.bayM configuration.
source_identity_mappings.limit: Declared model spacing convention is separate from actual measured member spacing, reference-cell geometry and matched boundary records; no spacing value copied.

source_identity_mappings.source_role: The source supplies aI divided by bay to gi as aISmeared.

gi(aI1 / bay, aTh1, aOe1, aSp1, SHIP0.giKnockdownFrame)

source_identity_mappings.limit: Source area-per-bay convention, including baseline-state call, is only an equivalent input identity. Area per spacing is not a measured discrete-cell stiffness.

source_identity_mappings.source_role: aO0 derives from wall.ring.A and ringPitchM; aO combines it with aOExtra.
source_identity_mappings.limit: Declared area-per-spacing and combined-area conventions do not independently establish actual member arrangement, stations, sections or connections.

source_identity_mappings.source_role: The source combines outer and inner smeared-area identities as abar.
source_identity_mappings.limit: Exact symbolic identity recorded without evaluation or independent derivation; no original homogenization derivation or validation is supplied by the formula itself.

source_identity_mappings.source_role: The source forms iEff from abar and declared depth.
source_identity_mappings.limit: An equivalent-section inertia identity is not observed effective stiffness, discrete connection response or licensed transfer to an assembled system. No inertia/stiffness/capacity value calculated.

requirements.existing_boundary: Published full-radius smearing limitation and source inputs remain model assumptions.
prospective_record_requirements: Original source/configuration/revision/domain and area-per-spacing/equivalent-section unit conventions, including inclusion/exclusion.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Source formula identities cannot supply measured response or cancel the station/section/connection limitation.

requirements.existing_boundary: Actual matched discrete reference cell and member spacing are unsupplied.
prospective_record_requirements: Original reference-cell/configuration/member-spacing records with matched source domain and applicability.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Declared bay/pitch/radius/depth conventions do not establish actual geometry or a representative assembled cell.

requirements.existing_boundary: Actual matched boundary and discrete connection response remain unknown.
prospective_record_requirements: Applicable boundary/connection configuration and response records, source custody and domain correspondence.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Equivalent-area input is not proof of discrete load transfer, effective stiffness, connection behavior or assembled-system response.

requirements.existing_boundary: Source contains symbolic equivalent-section identities, not a supplied original validation record.
prospective_record_requirements: Original derivation identity/revision/assumptions and matched validation records if supplied.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: A formula alone is not an independent derivation, homogenization calibration, sensitivity experiment or physical validation.

requirements.existing_boundary: No actual matched observation/raw custody accompanies the identities.
prospective_record_requirements: Unmodified original raw records, acquisition context, responsible custody and applicable calibration/uncertainty.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Repository gate PASS cannot replace measured effective stiffness or unknown validation; no new numerical uncertainty estimate.

requirements.existing_boundary: Continuum-equivalent versus discrete assembly transfer is unlicensed by this paper.
prospective_record_requirements: Matched reference/domain/applicability records, actual responsible owner and adoption source/version/criterion only when supplied.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Proposed custodian roles are unassigned; no geometry/member/section/connection/material/criterion/check/procedure or design chosen.
